newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe key index edges up in bullish market.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe key index edges up in bullish market.

text.p: Zimbabwe's industrial index closed 10.02 points firmer at 10,294.41 on Wednesday on the back of a rise in the demand for blue-chip shares, brokers said.
"We've seen a fair amount of demand for blue chips. I expect to see this trend continue but I don't expect it (index) to run away that much yet," one broker said.
Brokers say the market is only likely to get a firm direction after government unveils its 18-month budget in July.
Counters to trade firmer included Alloys which added 20 cents to 220 while blue chip conglomerate Delta at 1,735, finance house udc at 270 and cool drink firm Schweppes at 340 all put on 10 cents.
Rubber product manufacturers Acacia and pork producer Colcom were also 10 cents firmer at 210 and 425 respectively.
In minings, gold companies Ashanti and Falgold both traded at previous levels, but coal miners Wankie shed five cents to 570. The secondary mining index lost 28.58 points to close at 929.61.
